panels.title: Votes per day
panels.description: Read from v_grafana_votes via grafana_ro, which cannot see raw votes (cookie_token, ip_hash) -- see schema.sql decision 3 in docs/design/2026-08-24-grafana-datasources-design.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '1d') AS time, count(*) AS "ballots" FROM v_grafana_votes WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT p.name_en AS "party", r.vote_count AS "ballots" FROM rollup_national_previous r JOIN previous_parties p ON p.id = r.previous_party_id ORDER BY r.vote_count DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top upcoming parties (weighted)
panels.description: Ordered by weight, not vote_count. vote_count counts PICKS and a ballot may name up to 3 upcoming parties, so ordering on it gives a 3-party ballot triple the say. weight carries SUM(1.0/k) so each ballot totals exactly 1 -- see the comment above rollup_upcoming.weight in schema.sql.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name_en AS "party", r.weight AS "weighted ballots" FROM rollup_national_upcoming r JOIN upcoming_parties p ON p.id = r.upcoming_party_id ORDER BY r.weight DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Ballots by league
panels.description: club_id IS NULL selects the LEAGUE-SCOPE row. Each rollup carries one league-scope row per distinct league a ballot touched; summing club-scope rows instead would count a multi-team ballot once per club.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.name_en AS "league", sum(r.vote_count) AS "ballots" FROM rollup_previous r JOIN leagues l ON l.id = r.league_id WHERE r.club_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Vote switching
panels.description: Party-to-party crosstab from rollup_national_previous_upcoming (previous_party_id, upcoming_party_id, vote_count) -- NOT rollup_national_vote_switch, which only carries a 5-bucket switch_status (new_voter/undecided/stayed/hedging/switched) with no party columns at all. Verified against the live schema.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pp.name_en AS "voted last time", up.name_en AS "considering now", r.vote_count AS "ballots" FROM rollup_national_previous_upcoming r JOIN previous_parties pp ON pp.id = r.previous_party_id JOIN upcoming_parties up ON up.id = r.upcoming_party_id ORDER BY r.vote_count DESC LIMIT 50
